title: Zelensky thanks Melania Trump for mediation in securing ceasefire in Oleshky
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has thanked U.S. First Lady Melania Trump for her mediation in arranging a ceasefire in the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky and said Ukraine would support the continuation of the initiative.

title: Trump says peace deal between Ukraine and Russia getting closer
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has once again said that the United States is bringing an agreement to end the war in Ukraine closer.

title: Zelensky meets with Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, during a meeting with Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew, congratulated him on the 35th anniversary of his enthronement, which will be marked on November 2.

title: Russian strike destroys Kramatorsk city executive committee building
summary: A Russian airstrike has destroyed the building of the city executive committee in Kramatorsk, Donetsk region.

title: Four killed, including child, in car and truck collision in Dnipro
summary: Four people, including a child, have been killed in a road accident in Dnipro.

title: Cost of countering aerial threats should be proportionate to threat – defense industry representative
summary: The cost of countering an aerial threat should be proportionate to the cost of the threat itself, and European countries should take this into account as they develop their relevant technologies.

title: Zelensky awards 733 service members, including 255 posthumously
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has awarded state honors to 733 service members, including 255 posthumously.

title: SBU's Alpha unit sets record, neutralizing 3,198 Russian troops in one week
summary: Operators of the Alpha Special Operations Center of the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) neutralized 3,198 Russian troops in one week.

title: Heroin and cocaine not produced in Ukraine – police
summary: Heroin and cocaine are not manufactured in Ukraine, the National Police of Ukraine has said.

title: Ukraine and NATO to deepen cooperation on innovative technologies
summary: Deputy Minister of Defense of Ukraine Sergiy Boyev and representatives of NATO’s Defense Innovation Accelerator for the North Atlantic (DIANA) signed a memorandum of understanding to deepen cooperation in the joint development, testing and adoption of innovative technologies.

title: Russian drone attack injures two people in Kyiv region, damages homes and vehicles
summary: Two men were injured in a Russian drone attack in the Kyiv region in the morning of November 1.

title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Dnipro, sparking fire
summary: Russian forces attacked an industrial facility in Dnipro, causing a fire.

title: Drone technologies and countermeasures to develop in parallel in coming years – defense company CEO
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle technologies and countermeasures will continue to develop in parallel over the coming years, constantly adapting to each other.

title: Drones violate Moldovan airspace twice during massive Russian attack on Ukraine
summary: Two drones were detected in Moldovan airspace on Saturday, October 31, amid a massive Russian attack on Ukraine.

title: Zelensky reports strikes on Russian defense industry plant, air defense assets worth $70 million
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck the Kamensky chemical plant in Russia’s Rostov region, which is involved in missile production, as well as a Pantsir-S2 air defense system and a command-and-staff vehicle of the S-400 Triumf system. The total value of the air defense assets hit is estimated at approximately $70 million.

title: Russian drone attack damages homes, warehouse and vehicles in Lviv community
summary: Russian drone attacks have damaged residential buildings, a warehouse and vehicles in the Lviv community.

title: Russia launches nearly 2,000 attack drones, over 1,500 guided bombs, 44 missiles at Ukraine in one week – Zelensky
summary: Russia launched 1,940 attack drones, more than 1,580 guided aerial bombs and 44 missiles of various types, including 36 ballistic missiles, at Ukraine over the past week.

title: Child injured in Russian drone attack in Poltava region
summary: Debris from a Russian drone damaged a house in the Reshetylivka community in the Poltava region, injuring a child.

title: Russian forces stepping up efforts to expand control in northern Kharkiv region, border guards say
summary: Russian troops are making the strongest efforts to expand their area of control in the northern Kharkiv region. In the Chernihiv region, however, they currently lack sufficient forces to launch such attacks.

title: Russian attack sets house ablaze in Rivne region, injuring four
summary: A house caught fire in the Ostroh district of the Rivne region following a Russian attack, leaving four people injured.

title: Russian drone attacks damage energy facilities in Kyiv region, injure woman
summary: Russian drones attacked the Kyiv region over the course of the day, with damage reported in six districts and a woman injured.

title: Russian forces strike energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, leaving over 650 settlements without power
summary: Russian forces have attacked energy infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region, leaving more than 650 settlements without electricity.

title: Debris from Russian drones damages power lines, educational facility in Kirovohrad region
summary: Debris from Russian drones have damaged power lines, an educational facility and agricultural warehouses in the Kirovohrad region.

title: Russian forces attack energy facilities in Vinnytsia region, damage mobile communications tower
summary: Russian forces attacked energy facilities in the Vinnytsia region overnight, damaging a mobile communications tower.

title: Drones attack Lukoil refinery in Russia
summary: An industrial facility in the Kstovo district sustained significant damage in a drone attack on Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region overnight on November 1.

title: War update: 264 clashes on front lines over past day, Pokrovsk sector hottest
summary: A total of 264 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian troops were recorded on the front line on October 31.

title: Nearly 100,000 consumers remain without power in Dnipropetrovsk region following Russian attacks
summary: Nearly 100,000 consumers in the Dnipropetrovsk region remain without electricity following Russian attacks.

title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,100 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 1, 2026, have reached approximately 1,590,270 personnel, including 2,100 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

title: Air defense neutralizes 371 of 433 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 371 out of the 433 drones used by Russian troops to attack Ukraine since the evening of October 31.

title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia region 699 times in past 24 hours, six injured
summary: Russian troops launched 699 attacks on 55 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours. Six people were injured in enemy attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district.

title: Trump says he will invite Zelensky to G20 summit
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has said that he will invite Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to the G20 summit, which will be held in Miami in mid-December.
